measurement_boundary: Fixed serial HiGHS,threads1,parallel off,seed0,120s. Repeat3 only when the evaluator rule admits the complete set of variants under30s;preserve actual sample counts and timeouts.
Shared user host is not globally resource-isolated. No stable runtime distribution or prompt/API causal effect is inferred.
Solver Optimal means its reported tolerances,not an exact-rational optimum. No-incumbent,+Infinity/-Infinity,partial LP and raw false comparison flags remain visible.
The final fresh round ends the user-authorized run program;no further fresh round is planned. Memory is not an acceptance gate.
